messages:
maria (Marketing): Quick thread: need X + LinkedIn cadence for next week's benchmark webinar. Deliverables: hero post, 2 reminders, 4-tweet highlights thread, and post-webinar clip + recording CTA. Also confirm lead routing.

devin (Social): Draft schedule: Wed 10:00 PT hero, Mon reminder, Wed reminder, Day-of sign-up push, Fri follow-up. Will create tech + product copy variants.

ali (Design): I can produce hero PNG + 10s clip by tomorrow noon. Which color palette?

maria (Marketing): Use brand blue for LinkedIn, dark for X. Need square and 16:9.

devin (Social): Draft copy samples:
X tech: "New inference benchmark: cost vs latency across open models. Join our webinar to see practical ops wins. Register: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar?utm_source=x"
X product: "We benchmarked open models — faster answers at lower cost. Live webinar Wed. Seats limited: https://signup.redwood.ai/webinar"
LinkedIn long: short paragraph with methodology + speakers + CTA.

rachel (Growth): Paid boost: recommend hero + Wed reminder. Budget request $700. Target: ML infra, platform engineers.

sam (SDR): Route signups to SFDC queue "Bench_Webinar_Leads". Please include hidden fields: lead_source=bench_may, company_size, use_case. SDRs will triage in <48h.

post-bot: Scheduled draft created: 2026-05-12 17:00 UTC -> LinkedIn hero.

devin (Social): I'll add UTMs to all registration links and prepare saved replies for common Qs. Who handles live replies first hour?

rachel (Growth): I'll monitor and handle high-intent replies, then pass leads to Sam.

maria (Marketing): Perfect. Final checklist: copy variants approved, assets uploaded, UTMs on links, boost budget approval. React with :thumbsup: when done.

ali (Design): :thumbsup: assets uploaded -> https://files.redwood.ai/bench/may_assets.zip

devin (Social): :thumbsup: drafts queued pending asset attach.

rachel (Growth): :thumbsup: will confirm audiences by EOD.
